courses.overview: 從可追溯、完整且可重現的數位證據延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: 資安事件應變演練
related.why: 兩者都建立帶可信度的時間線
related.transfer: 兩者都建立帶可信度的時間線
related.difference: 鑑識不將急速恢復當成唯一目標
related.differenceEn: Forensics does not make rapid restoration its sole aim

place.name: NIST 研究城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「資安事件應變演練」共用的資料／元件介面；以「兩者都建立帶可信度的時間線」指出能保留的條件。
針對「鑑識不將急速恢復當成唯一目標」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with cybersecurity incident-response exercises; use "Both construct confidence-aware timelines" to identify retained conditions.
For "Forensics does not make rapid restoration its sole aim", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 機器學習資料版本管理
related.why: 兩者都需不可混淆的資料版本
related.transfer: 兩者都需不可混淆的資料版本
related.difference: 證據交接重視保全，ML 版本還需訓練重現
related.differenceEn: Custody emphasizes preservation; ML versioning also needs training reproduction

針對「證據交接重視保全，ML 版本還需訓練重現」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。

courses.summary: 數位鑑識證據保全從可追溯、完整且可重現的數位證據連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Digital-forensics evidence preservation connects interfaces, data and acceptance through traceable, intact and reproducible digital evidence. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「合法與任務範圍」到「儲存與刪除」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect authority and scope to retention and deletion, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: NIST 鑑識資料分開採集、檢查、分析與報告；本課只使用自行製作的映像與日誌。
history.textEn: NIST forensics distinguishes collection, examination, analysis and reporting; this course uses self-created images and logs.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.
